fixed_points.reason: retain v1/v2 composition as historical anchor

exceedances.reason: Eulerian answer distribution; no claim of mathematical unrelatedness

left_to_right_minima.reason: record/cycle distributions and run-count alternative, selected on development only

longest_decreasing_run.reason: count distribution and development learning-curve matching

source_lr: 3e-4; warmup100 and cosine to3e-5 at2400, then constant3e-5 through4800
precision: FP32 weights/evaluation; BF16 training; TF32 disabled
target_gate: seed17 single-task source-dev endpoint accuracy>=.90 and >=training-majority dev accuracy+.15; no transfer outcomes
replacement_rule: min TV + abs(endpoint dev accuracy gap) + mean absolute dev accuracy gap at600,1200,2400,3600,4800; candidate order breaks ties
single_task_reference: same per-seed initial model and source train/dev;4800 updates;also retain1200 equal-task-exposure checkpoint
selection: max dev answer accuracy; min dev answer CE; earliest update; declared LR order; step0 excluded
split_rule: full inverse/reverse/complement orbit exclusion across old and new roles/seeds; within-seed pools intentionally shared across targets and conditions
reuse: fixed_points seeds17/42 reuse exact v2 B/C4800 and A/B/C adaptation candidates with hashes and compatibility checks
scope: four targets,256 samples,three seeds; no sample-efficiency curve or scaling law; stop after report
